name: DB Live Transit
description: Provider integration for Deutsche Bahn RIS Maps live train positions

db-ris-maps.purpose: Realtime positions of Deutsche Bahn trains, shown as live vehicle markers on the map
db-ris-maps.dataSent: No user data or location is sent. The server requests journey positions for the configured administration IDs (default 80,81) using DB API credentials; the visible map area is applied as a local filter after the response.
db-ris-maps.dataReceived: Journey positions (coordinates, bearing, speed), line/journey labels and origin/destination names, and the update timestamp
